title: Quality
description: Declarative SQL or native function quality checks. Solutions configure their target runtime and table bindings.

maxFailureRatePct.description: Fail after valid target and metric writes when the distinct error-row percentage strictly exceeds this value. Omit to disable the gate.

references.description: Named active model entities, used in monitoring SQL as {references.alias}.

expression.description: Boolean SQL expression passed unchanged to the target engine. Define NULL handling explicitly, for example COALESCE(Amount >= 0, FALSE).

function.description: Native function name passed unchanged to the target engine. Mutually exclusive with expression; function availability is validated by the runtime.

arguments.description: Opaque native function arguments, including nested JSON values. Only with function; omitted arguments execute as an empty object.

sql.description: Monitoring-only query returning exactly one row with checked_rows and measured_value. Uses {target} and declared {references.alias} relations.

onEmpty.description: Only with sql. Defaults to evaluate; no_data reports NO_DATA when checked_rows is zero after result validation.
